items.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
items.summary: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

items.title: Major shareholder presses SkyAI on Solana sales after treasury shrinks 70% in a month
items.summary: SkyAI's SOL treasury fell 70% in under a month, with 400,000 SOL unexplained. Bastion Trading won't tender at $3 a share and wants $3.50.

items.title: Geo-Aware Leader Schedule
items.summary: This study evaluates SIMD-0675, a geo-aware leader schedule for Solana. It reorders the stake-weighted random schedule so that consecutive leaders are geographically close, which cuts handoff latency. No validator’s number of leader windows changes. Two parameters are tuned: STAK

items.title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Development Keeps Buying SOL as CHAD Preferred Stock Hits Record
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company now holds about 2.59 million SOL, but its weekly purchases keep shrinking.

items.title: More Breakpoint 2026 Speakers Confirmed for London
items.summary: Twelve more speakers join Breakpoint 2026 at Olympia London, taking the stage from 15–17 November across finance, trading and infrastructure.

items.title: Payments on Solana: September 2026 in Five Stories
items.summary: Payment Channels topped 1 million payments per second in testing as Solana stablecoin supply reached $17.3 billion and x402 share hit 76%.

items.title: Breakpoint 2026: Booked Breakpoint? Let's Get You Prepped (Part 2)
items.summary: Arrive at Breakpoint London 2026 ready for a 6,000-person event, with travel booked, devices secured, and your week mapped in advance.

items.title: Solana Changelog: October 8, 2026
items.summary: web3.js v3 is ready for general use, while Solana activates a feature gate to cut slot times from 250ms to 200ms after one epoch.

items.title: Samsung Partners with Solana to Natively Deliver Stablecoins in Samsung Wallet to 82 Million U.S. Galaxy Devices
items.summary: Beginning the last week of October 2026, Samsung Wallet will support USDC cross-border transfers on Solana across 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices.

items.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: September 2026
items.summary: September saw growth across tokenized stocks, stablecoins, payments, and DeFi. Tokenized equity supply reached $684 million, stablecoins hit $17.51 billion, and the network processed 3.18 billion non-vote transactions.

items.title: Solana Foundation Launches Solana DvP, an Atomic Settlement Program Built for Financial Institutions
items.summary: Onchain open-source delivery-versus-payment infrastructure, tailored for the world’s leading financial institutions

items.title: Introducing Solana Microscope: Program Monitoring and Alerts
items.summary: Microscope decodes Solana program and Squads multisig activity into Grafana dashboards and alerts for Slack, Telegram, and PagerDuty.

items.title: Solana x AI: The Democratization Layer
items.summary: Solana can give AI agents permissionless access to compute, training, identity, memory, and machine-native payments.

items.title: Solana Changelog: October 1, 2026
items.summary: Devnet lists Alpenglow as a notable feature gate alongside new Agave, Firedancer, Superbank, Web3.js, Kit, and program SDK releases.

anomalies.detail: Delinquent stake is 4.7 robust standard deviations above its 7-day baseline: a 622.2% move to 0.07 % from a typical 0.01.
